# VoltVisuals — Elite Video Editor & Motion Designer

> Official portfolio of Volt (VoltVisuals), an elite video editor and motion designer specializing in high-retention YouTube gaming edits, viral TikTok & Shorts pacing, cinematic color grading, 3D motion graphics, and audio Foley design.

## Specialized Disciplines & Capabilities
1. **High-Retention YouTube Gaming Edits**: Beat-synced cuts, high-velocity pacing, meme-literate timing, and psychological pattern interrupts calibrated to creator culture.
2. **Hooking Intros & Retention Engineering**: Engineered first 3 seconds with boom drops, cliffhangers, and visual hooks yielding up to 98.4% 3-second retention.
3. **3D Camera Movement & Spatial Tracking**: Dynamic perspective tracking, Z-axis parallax, optical blur, and Mocha 3D planar tracking.
4. **Cinematic Color Grading & VFX**: Clean green screen alpha keying, rotoscoping, volumetric light wraps, and customized cinematic LUTs.
5. **UI & On-Screen Demonstration**: Slick cursor tracking, HUD callouts, and clean software/product tours.
6. **Sound Design (Foley & SFX)**: Layered impact risers, auditory drop ramps, whooshes, and spatial sound mastering.

## Software & Technical Stack
- **Editing**: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve Studio
- **Motion & VFX**: Adobe After Effects, Mocha Pro, Blender (3D Camera Physics)
- **Audio Engineering**: Adobe Audition, iZotope RX
